name: The Medway Mills
summary: The Medway Mills is a premier mixed-use office and retail center located on Main Street in Medway, Massachusetts. This well-regarded property serves the MetroWest community with convenient professional and retail services, earning strong reviews for its quality facilities and accessible location.
demographics: The Medway Mills attracts a diverse demographic mix typical of suburban Massachusetts communities, including middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000. The primary trade area serves Medway and surrounding MetroWest communities with a customer base that skews toward professionals aged 30-55, homeowners with children, and retirees seeking convenient local shopping and services. Visitors demonstrate a preference for practical retail and professional services over luxury shopping, with strong demand for office space and community-oriented businesses that serve daily needs.
description: The Medway Mills stands as a premier mixed-use destination in the heart of Medway, Massachusetts, offering a unique combination of office and retail space that serves the vibrant MetroWest community. Located at 163 Main Street, this thoughtfully designed center has become an integral part of Medway's commercial landscape, providing convenient access to professional services and retail offerings for local residents and businesses. The property's strategic location along Main Street ensures high visibility and easy accessibility for both tenants and visitors throughout the day. With operating hours from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM, The Medway Mills caters to the busy schedules of working professionals and families alike. The center has earned an impressive 4.7-star rating from 22 reviews, reflecting its commitment to quality tenant services and well-maintained facilities that meet the evolving needs of the Medway community.
